title: Right to Examine — Free-Look Periods of Ashgrove Fixed Indexed Annuities
content:
**Owner notice table — free-look periods, Fixed Indexed Annuities**

Free-look periods are counted in calendar days from the contract delivery date.

| Period | IndexEdge 5 | IndexEdge 7 | IndexEdge 10 | IndexEdge 10 Bonus | IncomeShield 7 | IncomeShield 10 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free-look period (calendar days) | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Free-look period when the contract replaced another annuity or life policy (calendar days) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Owner age on the issue date at or above which the senior period applies | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Senior free-look period (calendar days) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |

### The figures in words

- The free-look period is 10 calendar days.
- Where the contract replaced another annuity or life policy, the replacement period of 30 calendar days applies.
- Where the owner was 60 or older on the issue date, the senior period of 30 calendar days applies.

### Hypothetical owners

| Owner age on the issue date | Replacement sale | Periods named in the table that fit the facts |
|---|---|---|
| 59 | No | 10 days |
| 60 | No | senior 30 days |
| 45 | Yes | replacement 30 days |
| 72 | Yes | replacement 30 days and senior 30 days |
